tei:div.tei:p: nā ma bi dza hā ra sa m+pa ro lu hi pa s+yā bhi sa ma yo ma hā su kho dz+wa la kāḥ ཿ༄༅/ /bde mchog lū hi pa'i mngon rtogs bde chen rol mtsho bzhugs so/ /

na mo mañju badz+ra ya/ dpal ldan rgyal ba kun gyi lhan skyes bde/ khyab bdag mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar kha sbyor che/ /yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam rol du/ /legs shar bde mchog 'khor lor gus phyag 'tshal/ /gang la bsten pas srid zhi'i phun tshogs la/ /gegs med bde blag spyod pa'i dpal 'byung ba/ /dpal ldan 'jam mgon bla ma'i dge legs kyis/ /'gro 'di srid pa'i bar du rtag skyongs shig /'khor lo bsdom pa'i go 'phang bde blag tu// sgrub byed grub chen lū hi pa yi lugs/ /rim pa dang po'i nyams len skyon bral zhing*| |yon tan kun rdzogs deng 'dir snyad par bya/ /de yang spyir bskyed rim gyi rnam gzhag 'gros bzhir byed tshul sogs gzhan du brjod zin pa ltar lugs 'di sgong skyes glu ni med pa ste/ /sgra dang sgra min spang ba'o/ /zhes pa las gzhan du mi 'thad cing*/ rtsa rgyud du/ yang na rus sbal dag gi'o/ zhes pa'i lam yin pas mngon byang lnga las rten dang brten pa cig car du skyed pa'i lam 'gros yin la/ de ltar yin phyin chad phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor go cha dang bcas pa sgrub tshul khyad par can de las gcig car du grub par rigs so/ /des na rten 'byung bzhi ri rab sna tshogs pad rdor dang bcas pa sa bon so so la bskyed pa'i steng du mngon byang lnga las gzhal yas khang dngos kyi rten dang brten pa gcig car du bskyed par nges pas na/ sngar gyi pad rdor ni rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i 'og tu non cing gsar du grub pa yang rgya bod sus kyang ma bshad la/ khyad par dā ri ka pas| dkyil 'khor gyi rnam dag gi skabs su dngos po thams cad gcig nyid du| |sprul sku'i mdzad pa rdzogs gyur pa/ /dur khrod yin te lus su dag /ye shes snang ba kun khyab cing*/ /bdud bcom 'od dang rdo rjer ldan/ /mi mnyam med par zur bzhi pa/ /zhes sogs 'dis lugs 'di la dur khrod me ri'i phyi ru yod pa dang*/

bsrung 'khor thun mong ba'i nang na dbyibs kyi chos 'byung gru gsum med cing de med pas lugs 'di la'ang dus 'khor bzhin du sna tshogs pad rdor rdo rje sa gzhi'i steng du med pa ni legs par grub cing*/ rnal 'byor rdzogs phreng gi dgongs pa yang snang mod kyi bod kyi mkhas pa snga phyi kun gyis ma dgongs so/ /de bzhin du rnam dag bsgom pa'i tshe yang rten gyi rnam dag chad cing*| rgyan dang phyag rgya'i rnam dag sngags rnams dang sbyor ba'i tshe na/ sngags brjod nas de las byung ba'i mgul rgyan zhes sogs brjod pa ni mi 'thad de/ rgyan dang phyag rgya de dag sngar nas lus la bkod zin pa rnams ni sngar las gsar du skyed don med la/ ma bkod pa gsar du 'god na ni zlos pa dang*/ mngon byang lnga las cig char skyes tshar ba re dang sngar las gsar du skyed pa re re ste cha gnyis gnas so sor 'god mi shes pa'i phyir ro/ /rnal 'byor chen po la rdzogs rim kyi khyab pa bzo ba mi rigs ste/ bskyed rim la rnal 'byor bzhi ma tshang bar 'gyur la de lta na bskyed rim la lam gyi lus yongs rdzogs med pas rdzogs rim kyi smin byed du mi 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang skabs gzhan du mar/ bla med kyi rnal 'byor bzhi par byas la lus kyi dbu ma'i rtsa 'khor khyad par can la gnad du bsnun pa yod pa rdzogs rim dang med pa bskyed rim du byas nas/ 'di'i lus dkyil gyi gtso bo yab yum/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus kyi dhu ti nang sogs kyi dpyid dang thig le gnyis yongs su gyur nas dhu ti'i nang du byed pa dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po rdzogs rim du 'dod bzhin du sgoms pa lte ba'i bar snang rang kha ba la byas pa yang*/ bskyed rim rdzogs rim du dang rdzogs rim bskyed rim du thal bas gnod do/ /des na de ltar bshad pa'i lung thams cad ni nag po spyod pa'i rdzogs rim dpyid thig du grags pa dang de gang nas bton pa'i saṃ pu ṭi la sogs pa'i rgyud tshig yin pas skabs ma 'brel lo/

/de bzhin du phyogs mdog shar dkar po dang nang mchod byin rlabs shar du rnam snang bshad pa sogs kyi lung thams cad kyang nag po pa'i phyogs kyi lung yin la de ni pha rgyud sgo bstun dang*/ 'di ni ma rgyud dngos so/ /rnal 'byor ma gtso bor byas pa'i rnam gzhag yin pas khungs su mi 'byor ro/ /des na spyir bde mchog la dbang bzhi pa'i lam gtso bor byed pa gnyis med bde mchog /gsum pa gtso bor byed pa ma rgyud dngos kyi bde mchog gsang dbang gtso bor byed pa pha rgyud sgo bstun gyi bde mchog ste gsum du gnas pa kho bo'i rnam dpyod kyis legs par rnyed pas lung gsum so sor 'grel dgos pa las gzhan gnyis legs par brjod zin/ 'dir lugs gnyis pa'i rnam gzhag dpal mngon par rtogs pa sor bzhag cing*/ rigs mthun gzhan nas cung zad kha bskang te bshad par bya ba la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi/ 'jug go /dang po la ring ba'i dang*/ nye ba'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po ni lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs shing 'di'i dbang thob/ dam tshig dang sdom pa dag par byas nas skabs gzhan du skyabs 'gro dang yig brgyas rgyud sbyangs pa'o/ / gnyis pa la sngon 'gro gtor ma sbyin/ skyabs 'gro yig brgya brjod/ sgo gsum dag par bya/ phung khams byin gyis rlabs/ 'gal rkyen bsrung bas zlog mthun rkyen tshogs gnyis bsags pa'o/ / dang po ni/ gnas dang yo byad mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dngos sam bsam pas kyang rung ste/ sgrub grogs mang nyung gang 'byor dang bcas pas bde ba'i gtan la 'dug ste/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal he ru ka skug mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa g.yas rkyang gis bzhugs pa la/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud par gyur/ de nas nang mchod byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐/

gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha wa shung+nghaḥsarba dharma swa bha wa shudho3 haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las byung pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa de'i steng du raṃ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa grwa gsum du raṃ gyis mtshan pa de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las byung ba'i mi mgo sgyed bu gsum la gnas shing a dkar po las thod pa dum bu gcig pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang gi shar du hūm̐ mthing kha las byung ba'i dri chu hūm̐ gis mtshan pa byang du khaṃ ljang khu las byung ba'i klad pa khaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ nub tu aṃ dmar po las byung ba'i byang sems dkar po aṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lho ru traṃ ser po las byung ba'i rak+ta traṃ gyis mtshan pa/ dbus su oṃ dkar po las byung ba'i dri chen oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mer laṃ dkar po las byung ba'i ba lang gi sha laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ bden bral du maṃ sngon po las byung ba'i khyi'i sha maṃ gyis mtshan pa/ rlung du paṃ dmar po las byung ba'i glang po che'i sha paṃ gyis mtshan pa/ dbang ldan du tāṃ ljang khu las byung ba'i rta'i sha tāṃ gyis mtshan pa dbus su/ baṃ dmar po las byung ba'i mi'i sha baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos pa las me sbar ba'i drod kyis rdzas rnams yi ge dang bcas pa zhu nas nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar ser du gyur/ de'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po las byung ba'i kha trāṃ ga dkar po byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can mgo bo thur du bltas pa thod par lhung ste zhu bas bcud de dag dngul chu'i mdog can bsil bar gyur/ oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/

ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yi ge de nyid kha dog sna tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i steng du gnas pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las oṃ dkar po āḥdamar po hūm̐ sngon po rnams steng nas steng du gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rgya mtsho la sogs na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi dang/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo dbang phyug ma thams cad kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug cing*| 'od zer gyis 'gro ba rnams 'khor lo gsum gyi lhar byas pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo bkug pa rnams kyang snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas zhu ba yi ge gsum la thims zhing*/ de gsum yang rim gyi zhu bas thod par thims par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod de byin gyis rlob bo/ /sngon 'gro gtor ma'i mchod pa byin brlabs ni/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nya na badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ mchod rdzas rnams stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las kaṃ las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ me togabadug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ rnam pa mchod rdzas so so'i rnam pa can/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can ster bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā t+yaṃ āḥhū ྃ/ oṃ añca mā naṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wit+ye= oṃ shab+ta āḥhū ྃ/ de nas sngon 'gro'i gtor ma byin brlabs rgyas pa nang mchod byin brlabs bzhin nam/ bsdu na ha ho hriḥ kha dog dri nus kyi skyon bcom zhing bdud rtsir gyur oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis rgya cher spel zhing byin gyis rlabs par gyur/ pheṃ rang gi thugs kar nyi gdan la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/

dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang*/ zhing skyong la sogs pa thams cad spyan drangs ste/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'khod pa skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug pa las/ bde mchog gi lha yab yum gyi skur bzhengs pa'i mgron rnams kyi ljags la hūm̐ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dkar po nas 'bru tsam 'khod pa'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khwa hi/ sarba yak+ṣa| rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi sha tsa/ un+man+da/ a pa sma ra/ badz+ra ḍ+ḍa ka dwa ki n+ya da ya/ i maṃ/ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu/ sa ma ya/ rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sing+nghi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the baṃ/ ya the ṣ+taṃ/ bhu dza tha/ pī ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba karma/ sad su khaṃ bi shung+ngha ye/ sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swa hā/ zhes lan gnyis brjod pas phyogs dang mtshams la gnas pa la dbul lo/ /de nas shṝ he ru ka argaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swāhā nas shap+ta pra tī ts+tsha swāhwa/ dur khrod na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /klu'i tshogs = /gnod sbyin= /srin po'i= /'byung po'i tshogs= /yi dwags = /sha za'i = /smyo byed= /brjod byed= /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs= /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang/ /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir// thugs dam bcas zhing zhal gyi mches pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' stod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ / gdul dka' 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing/ /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la bstsol/

/ rnal 'byor 'di zhes bya ba 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya cher kun thob cing*/ / zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la bstsaul/ /bsrung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig/dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*/ /dge legs thams cad byung ba dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /yig brgya brjod/ badz+ra muṃḥ/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ de nas bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa bsang sbyangs kyang snga ma bzhin du byas sgrub grogs yod na zhu 'bul dang maṇ+ḍal dbul ba sogs bya'o/ / gnyis pa la gnyis las skyabs 'gro ni/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ / rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su 'chi/ /theg pa gsum po thams cad dang*/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu skyabs su 'chi bar bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ bdag ni he ru kar gyur nas// sems can thams cad he ru ka'i/ /go 'phangs mchog la dgod par bgyi/ / yig brgya ni rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las| rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ/ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣi ka ta sa ma ya shrī āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas/ sku ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu 'khyil ba yongs su gyur ba las mi skyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ gi mtha' mar yig ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis bskor bar gyur/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems pas bdag gzhan thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig gi nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas thugs ka'i sngags phreng hūm̐ dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs sangs rgyas sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul| de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas thugs ka'i sngags phreng hūm̐ dang bcas pa la thims/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po babs pa yab yum gnyis kyi sbyor mtshams nas 'thon/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dgalus ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dkar mer gyis gang*/ rtogs pa dang yon tan rang gzhan thams cad kyi rgyud la skyes par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ /badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/

sarba sid m+me pra yatsh+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+ta shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wān/ he ru ka mā me muñja he ru ko bha wa ma ha/ zhes sogs brjod kyang rung*/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ā me muñja badz+rir bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa nyer gcig sogs bzlas/ de nas bla ma bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs 'chi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang nyid la thims pas rang gi sgo gsum dang rdo rje sems pa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med par gyur/ gsum pa ni / shrī he ru ka he ni kun gyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i sems ste rgyu'i bdag nyid du rtag par bya bas stong pa'i chos kyi bdag med pa dang*/ ru ni gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gi dra bas bkod pa'i bdag dang bral ba'i gang zag gi bdag med pa dang*/ ka ni de kho na nyid kyi yul yul can gnyis mi mthun par so sor gnyis su mi gnas pa dang*/ shrī ni yul stong pa nyid ji 'dra ba de bzhin du rjes su zhugs pa'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes e waṃ gyi don no/ / stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis he ru ka sngon po zhes pa nas rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud par gyur/ sems can thams cad la phan bde'i bsam pas/ shṝ he ru ka ko3 haḥlan gsum brjod de nas mgor oṃ dang mthar hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar ba'i dbyangs gsal tshar gsum brjod de/ rang gi lte ba'i phyogs su sngags 'phreng 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa g.yon bskor gyis lan gsum du bskor te gnas pa las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs 'phros pa/

sna bug g.yas pa nas 'thon te/ phyogs bcur 'phros pas bgegs thams cad skrod de/ slar byon nas rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs te lte ba'i sngags phreng la thims par gyur| sems can thams cad bde ba thams cad dang ldan par gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad thob zin gyi bde ba brtan par gyur cigasems can thams cad yid de bzhin nyid la ro gcig tu gnas par gyur cigabazhi pa ni phung khams bskyed mched dag par byas pas kun nas bslangs ba'i mchod pa la sogs pa ni/ myur du byang chub 'grub par byed pas/ 'di rnams bsgom par lū hi pa'i 'grel pa rnams nas bshad pas/ 'di ltar gzugs phung la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su bsgom par bya ste/ rang gi dpral ba'i dbus su bruṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang dkar po phyag g.yas 'khor lo 'chang zhing*/ g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ lte bar aṃ ser po yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nyi ma ser po g.yas rin po che 'chang zhing*/ g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mgrin par hrī dmar po yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po g.yas pad+ma dmar po 'chang zhing*/ g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rkang pa gnyis kyi long bu'i 'og tu ho ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rgyal po ljang khu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'char zhing g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ snying khar hūm̐ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ spyi gtsug du he nag po yongs su gyur pa las he ru ka nag po g.yas sa gnon gyi phyag rgyas rdo rje 'dzin cing*/ g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/

de bzhin du sbyar ste/ mig gnyis su oṃ dkar po las gti mug rdo rje dkar po g.yas 'khor lo 'chang zhing*| g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ rna ba gnyis su hūm̐ nag po las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po g.yas thugs kar rdo rje 'dzin cing*/ g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ sna bug gnyis su traṃ ser po las ser sna rdo rje ser po g.yas rol pa dang bcas pas rin po che 'char zhing*/ g.yon rol pa dang bcas pas dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ lce'i rtsa bar aṃ dmar po las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po g.yas rol pa dang bcas pas pad+ma dmar po= dpral ba'i dbus su kaṃ ljang khu las phrag dog rdo rje ljang khu g.yas rol pa dang bcas pas sna tshogs rdo rje = snying gar haṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las dbang phyug rdo rje dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum pa ral pa'i cod pan can phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa g.yas rkyang gis bzhugs pa'o/ /lte ba sa la lāṃ ser po las ltung byed ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis gri gug dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha trāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ snying kha chu la maṃ nag po las gsod byed nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis gri gug dang rdo rje g.yon gnyis sogs= mgrin pa me la paṃ dmar po las 'gugs byed ma dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis gri gug dang pad+ma gnyis = dpral bar rlung la tāṃ ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las gar gyi dbang phyug ma ljang khu zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang = gsang gnas nam mkha'i khams la khaṃ dud kha yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma'i dra ba can dud kha rtsa zhal dud kha g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gri gug tshangs mgo lcags kyu/

g.yon thod pa kha trāṃ ga dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum pa skra grol ba gcer mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyangs gis bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ pra kṛ ta pa ri shung+nghaḥsarba dharma pra kṛ ta pa ri shung+ngho3 haṃ/ lnga pa ni rang lha bcu bdun lus la gnas pa'i he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis/ lag pa g.yon pa'i 'theb mdzub kyis phyogs rer se gol gtog pa sngon du 'gro bas oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar du sngags de nyid kha dog nag po/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang du sngags de nyid kha dog ljang khu/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub tu sngags de nyid kha dog dmar po/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lhor sngags de nyid kha dog ser po rnams 'khod par gyur/ sngags de rnams la rang rang gi kha dog can gyi 'od zer 'phros pas steng tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas 'og gser gyi sa gzhi la thug par khyab pa'i 'od zer 'bar ba'i gzugs chen po rnams su gyur/ sngags 'od zer dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las shar nag byang ljang nub dmar lho ser ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi pa tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa'i bar du khyab par gyur/ ra ba grub pa dang dus mnyam du hūm̐ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyis 'og gi sa gzhi thams cad sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ gis 'od zer las phyi rol du steng dang logs kun tu khyab par rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa can gyi mda'i dra ba dang/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje gur dang*/ gur gyi 'og ra ba'i steng du rdo rje'i bla re rnams bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gnas par gyur/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gnyis brjod shar dang steng du sngags de nyid kha dog nag po gnyis yongs su gyur pa las kha gdong ma nag mo gnyis/

oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa| byang du sngags de nyid kha dog ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gnyis brjod nub dang 'og tu sngags de nyid kha dog dmar po gnyis yongs su gyur pa las khyi gdong ma dmar mo gnyis/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan badz+ra rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lhor sngags de nyid kha dog ser po yongs su gyur pa las phag gdong ma ser mo/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha/ oṃ ā na ya/ shar lhor sngags de gnyis kha dog nag po dang ser po 'od zer dang bcas pa gnyis 'dres te yongs su gyur pa las gshin rje'i brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ oṃ ā na ya/ oṃ ā gṛh+ṇa pā ya/ lho nub tu sngags de nyid kha dog ser po dang dmar po 'od zer dang bcas pa gnyis 'dres te yongs su gyur pa las gshin rje'i pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ nub byang du sngags de nyid kha dog dmar po dang ljang khu sogs gshin rje 'chi ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa/ oṃ sum+bha/ byang shar du sngags de nyid kha dog ljang khu dang nag po sogs gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba thams cad kyang zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis ma/ lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa can/ g.yas kyi tho ba dang g.yon gyi rang 'dra'i phur bu bsnams pa de rnams kyis rang 'dra du ma spros pas phyogs bcu'i bgegs gdug pa can thams cad bkug ste/ rdo rje ra ba'i phyi rol dang nye bar hūm̐ hūm̐ ring po nag po bcu las grub pa'i khron pa 'brub khung gi rnam pa can du bcug par gyur oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+tan hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kā+-i la ya k-i la ya sarba pa paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ra adz+nya pa ya ti/ sarba duṣ+ta bi ghan+ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa| shar nas phyogs g.yon bskor dang me nas mtshams g.yas bskor dang steng 'og du bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bu zug

oṃ badz+ra murga ra badz+ra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ khro mo rnams kyi phyag g.yas kyi rdo rje tho bas brdungs pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du son par phur bu btab pas bgegs thams cad bde stong dbyer med kyi ngo bor ro gcig tu gyur/ kha gdong ma la sogs pas bgegs lhag ma rnams rgyang ring du bskrad nas rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi pa la thims pas/ chu la chu brdabs pas zegs ma phyir 'thor ba bzhin du 'od zer phyir 'phros pa las/ rdo rje dang pad+ma 'khor lo'i rwa ba zlum po gsum bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i me kha dog sna lnga pa g.yon bskor du 'khyil zhing 'bar ba steng dang logs kun tu khyab pas 'gro ba thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad du bgegs dang bral bar gyur/ oṃ me de ni badz+rir bha wa badz+ra ban+bha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūm̐ paṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañja ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐| oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la hūm̐ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ drug pa la gnyis las/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ bsrung 'khor gyi dbus na rang he ru kar gnas pa'i thugs kar paṃ ser po las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin dbus sngo la mtha' skya ba ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi 'od zer gyi rang gi spyi bo nas rkang pa'i bar gang te thog ma med pa nas kyi sgo gsum gyi dri ma rnams sbyangs pas lus shel sgong bzhin tu dag par gyur ste/ ba spu'i sgo nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis 'og min nas bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang lha dang lha mo dang khro bos nam mkhar khams til gyi gang bu ltar gang ba mdun du spyan drangs 'od zer rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ la thims/

gang gi drin gyi bde chen gnas/ / skad cig gis ni thob 'gyur ba/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang*/ /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing*/ /'dus dang dur khrod gnas pa yi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma| |kun la bdag ni gus phyag 'tshal/ /rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ shrī he ru ka ar+ghaṃ pra trīts+tsha swāhā/ pā t+yaṃ= oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhū ྃswā ha/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe= dī pe= gan+dhe= nai wi t+ye= shap+ta pra tītsh+tsha āḥ hūm̐ swā hā/ rig ma bcu drug ni/ oṃ badz+ra bī ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra waṃ she= badz+ra mṛ taṃ ge= badz+ra mu ra dze= badz+ra hā s+ya badz+ra la s+ya badz+ra gīrte badz+ra nṝ te badz+ra puṣ+pe badz+ra dhu pe badz+ra dī paṃ badz+ra gan+dhe rū pa badz+rir sa badz+ri spar+she badz+ri dharma dha tu badz+ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lha mo de rnams kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan sogs gzhan du shes par bya'o| |de nas rkang pa brgyad pas bstod par bya ste/ oṃ bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du mgo bor oṃ dang mthar hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar/ kun nas bskal pa chen po'i me'i 'od/ /ral pa'i cod pan mi bzad pa dang ldan/ /mche ba gtsigs pa bsgyur zhing 'jigs pa'i zhal// stong phrag phyag ni 'bar ba'i 'od zer can/ /dgra sta zhags gdengs mdung dang kha ṭaṃ 'dzin/ /stag gi lpags pa'i nam za 'dzin pa can/ /dud chen mun nag dang 'dra'i sku la 'dud/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs 'chi| |sdig pa thams cad so sor gshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yid rangs| |sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ byang chub bar du bdag skyabs 'chi/

/rangagazhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir| byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyid/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog /sgrod dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /bdag gis 'gro rnams sgral ba'i phyir/ /rang gi bdag nyid skad cig ma/ /sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bgyid| |de nas yig brgya tshar gcig brjod pas gsol ba gdab/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs ni/ mchod yul dang mchod mkhan dang mchod rdzas rnams rnam par rig pa'i sems kyi brtags pa tsam du zad do/ /rang gi spyi bor he dkar po/ mgrin par ru dmar pa/ snying khar ka mthing kha de gsum gyi don rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i rgyu dang brjod pa dang bral ba dang*/ gang du yang mi gnas pa nyid do/ / sems can rnams kyis chos rnams kyi yin tshul 'di lta bu ma shes pas 'khor bar 'khyams pas na/ bdag gis he ru ka'i go 'phangs mngon du byas la bzung 'dzin bden pas stong ba'i sems can gyi yin tshul 'di rtogs par bya ste 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar bar bya'o/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shung+ngho3 haṃ| khams gsum po rang bzhin gyi ma grub par gyur/

dngos gzhi la bzhi ste/ 'chi ba chos skur 'khyer ba rnal 'byor gyi lam/ bar do longs skur 'khyer ba rjes su rnal 'byor gyi lam/ skye ba sprul skur 'khyer ba shin tu rnal 'byor gyi lam/ rdzogs rim dang shin tu mthun pa rnal 'byor chen po'i lam mo// dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las yi ge gsum po yongs su gyur pa las smon lam gyi dbang gis rang gi sems de steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'i oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon por gyur/ de gsum las rim pa bzhin du sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams spros te/ sa 'og dang mi yul dang mtho ris rnams 'khor lo gsum gyi lhar byas snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas sku'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams zhu ba oṃ la thim/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams zhu ba aḥl thims/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams zhu ba hūm̐ la thim/ oṃ yang āḥl thim| āḥyang hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gis zhabs kyu u ni ha la thim ha'i lus ni mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo zla tshes la thim/ zla tshes thig le la thim/ thig le na dā la thim| na dā yang skra'i rtse mo brgya stong gi cha'i tshad tsam du gnas par gyur/ sems can rnams kyi chos nyid ma rtogs pas 'khor bar 'khyams pas na/ bdag gis chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs par bya ste/ rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa'i sems can rnams kyis kyang chos nyid khong du chud par bya ste/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar bar bya'o/ /oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ na dā yang mi dmigs par gyur/ 'dir phyis kyi mkhas pa chen pos sku gsum lam 'khyer bskyed rim gyis dngos gzhir bzhed bzhin du bsgrub thabs kyi chings dang lag len la 'chi ba chos sku'i rnal 'byor khyad par ba lugs 'di'i thun mong min pa'i khyad chos snang ba mtha' dag gi bsdud rim yod pa sngon 'gro'i nang du bsdus pa ni grub mtha' dang lag len 'gal lo/

/ gnyis pa la gsum/ bar do mtshon byed nā da nam mkhar bzhag/rten 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs pad rdor rnams bskyed/ /mngon byang dang po me long ye shes dang*/ /gnyis pa mnyam nyid ye shes bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de ltar snang ba thams cad bsdus pa'i stong pa nyid las langs te rang gi sems na dā'i gzugs gyen du 'greng ba shin tu phra ba/ dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ nam mkha'i khams mtha' yas pa'i chos 'byung gi nang du yaṃ sngon po yongs su gyur pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngon po dbyibs gzhu lta bu g.yas g.yon gnyis su rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ dmar po yongs su gyur pa las me'i dkyil 'khor kha dog dmar po dbyibs gru gsum pa grwa gsum raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las chu'i dkyil 'khor kha dog dkar po dbyibs zlum po dbus su bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ ser po yongs su gyur pa las sa'i dkyil 'khor kha dog ser po dbyibs gru bzhi pa grwa bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suṃ yongs su gyur pa las ri rab lhun po gru bzhi pa rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin steng gi phyogs mtshams su cog brgyad kyi nye bar mdzes pa/ de'i steng du paṃ ser po yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs pad+ma/ de'i lte bar hūṃ nag po yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i steng gi lte bar paṃ las lte ba dang tshad mnyam pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lte ba dang ge sar dang ldan pa phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma dmar| me rlung gnyis ser/ bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan nag lte ba ljang*/ ge sar ser ba'o/ / gsum pa ni / sna tshogs pad+ma chung ngu'i dbus su mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥ ste dbyangs dkar po bcu drug pa phrag gcig g.yas skor dang*/

slar yang a ā nas g.yon skor ste gnyis ka'ang rim pa gcig gis 'khod/ de'i phyir rol du dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍa ḍha ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da da dha dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma| ya ya ra la la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥste gsal byed dmar po bzhi bcu pa phrag gcig g.yas skor dang*/ slar yang ka kha nas/ k+ṣa ste gsal byed dmar po bzhi bcu pa phrag gcig g.yon skor ste gnyis ka'ang rim pa gcig gis 'khod/ de gnyis yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can la dbyangs so gnyis dang gsal byed brgyad cu rnams gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin du snang ba'i ā li dang zla ba'i kha dog dkar ba'-i cha ni me long lta bu'i ye shes kā li dang zla ba'i kha dog dmar ba'i cha ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ / gsum pa la bar dos mngal bzung ba sor rtog ye shes/ des rang gzhan gyis don mdzad pa bya grub yeshes/ rten dang brten pa gcig char rdzogs pa chos dbyings ye shes/ dang po ni/ rang nam mkha'i nā das zla ba dkar la dmar ba mthong ba na/ bdag gis sangs rgyas yab yum kyi byams sems dkar dmar gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dbus su skye ba slangs la/ sems can gyi don bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa dang ldan pas zla ba'i dbus su nā da zhugs pa las thig le de las zla phyed de las mgo bo/ de las ha'i lus de las u grub pa'i tshul gyis dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gyi hūm̐ yig rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin can du rdzogs par gyur pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ / gnyis pa ni hūm̐ yig las kha dog sna lnga pa'i 'od zer 'phros ba'i rtse mo las 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs rnams 'thon te 'gro ba rnams 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs kyi go 'phangs la bkod pa dang*/ sngon thog ma med pa nas grub pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i zhing khams na bzhugs pa rnams lhan cig spyan drangs tai mnyam par sbyor ba sngon du 'gro bas zhu nas hūm̐ yig gi nā da la thim zhing*/

hūm̐ yig lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ / gsum pa la sngags gsum brjod cing nga rgyal bzung*/ dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal gdab/ de byang phyogs kyi ngo bor bsgom/ lus dkyil dang go cha gsal gdab/ de la ye shes pa bzhug cing dbang bskur/ mchod bstod dang dag pa rgyas par bsgom pa'o/ / dang po ni oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni kā ya wak+tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shung+ngha sarba dharma badz+ra shung+ngho3 haṃ/ zla ba dbyangs gsal hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor lus dkyil go cha dang bcas pa thams cad dus gcig du grub par gyur pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ / gnyis pa ni/ de yang sna tshogs pad+ma chung ngu la sogs pa'i steng du rdo rje sa gzhi la gnas pa'i khang pa brtsigs pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin du sngo ljang dmar ser dkar ba'i rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i rtsegs pas skor ba'i steng na rin po che'i pha gu gzhi dmar po la rin po che zur gsum dang gru bzhi la sogs pas spras pa/ de'i steng na gnas pa'i gser gyi ske rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyang ba'i mu tig do shal dang do shal phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i phyi ngos su bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i shar bu/ de'i steng du mda' yab pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyis yongs su bskor ba'i bar bar du gser gyi bum pa nas 'thon pa'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan brgyad brgyad kyi mdzes par byas pa/ phyi'i steng gi zur bzhi la gdugs bzhis brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i 'gram nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba la gnas pa'i bzhugs stabs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi phyi'i mtshams dang rtsig pa'i phyi nang gi zur bzhir zla phyed la gnas pa'i rin po che dmar po'i steng na rdo rjes brgyan pa/

sgo bzhi'i so sor mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta 'bab snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du bum pa bzang po las skyes pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing la rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang bar bar du grub pa thob pa dang sprin gyi bseb nas byung ba'i lha mo me tog gi phreng ba bzung ba rnams kyis kun nas 'dzes par byas pa'o| |de'i phyi rol du sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra bas bskor ba la sogs pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo de'i phyi rol du bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi me lta bu'i rdo rje'i me kha dog sna lnga pas steng dang logs kun tu khyab par g.yon bskor du 'khyil zhing 'bar ba'o/ /de'i phyi rol na gnas pa'i dur khrod brgyad ni/ shar du gtum drag byang du tshang tshing 'khrig pa/ nub tu rdo rje 'bar ba/ lhor keng rus can/ dbang ldan du drag tu dgod dang*/ mer bkra shis tshal/ bden bral du mun pa drag po/ rlung du ki li ki'i sgra sgrog pa'i dur khrod de/ ro mgo med dang*/ 'gags ste shing la dpyangs pa dang*/ sa la 'gyel ba dang*/ gsal shing la skyon pa dang*/ mdung gis phug pa dang*/ phyed tshig pa dang*/ mgo thod dang*/ byin pa'i rus pa dang*/ gtsigs pa'i mgo bo dang*/ de las gzhan pa'i rus pa 'thor ba dang ma 'thor ba'i keng rus rnams bcal du bkram pa'i gnas su gyur pas na dur khrod do/ de bzhin du phyogs rnams shar nas g.yon bskor dang*/ mtshams rnams dbang ldan nas g.yas skor du rim pa bzhin 'og ma kun la 'gre bar byas te/ de na gnas pa'i shing brgyad ni/ shar du shar+ṣi/ a shwad tha/ kaṅka la/ tsu ta/ dbang ldan du ba ṭa| kā rañja/ pa ṭa parka/ rlung du par thi ba rnams so/ /shing gi rtsa bar gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad ni/ dbang po ser po rab brtan dkar po la zhon pa g.yas 'og ma rdo rje 'dzin pa/

gnod sbyin ser po mi la zhon pa ne'u le rin po che skyug pa 'dzin pa/ chu lha dkar po gdengs ka bdun ldan chu srin la= sbrul zhags= gshin rje sngon po ma he=dbyug pa= dbang phyug chen po dkar po glang la= rtse gsum= me lha dmar po ra skyes= phreng ba spyi blugs dang bcas pa= srin po sngon po gcer bu mi mgo'i phreng ba'i cod pan/ ro langs= ral gri= rlung du rlung lha ljang khu sha ba la zhon pa g.yas 'og ma ba dan ser po 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyor zhing*/ g.yon 'og ma thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa'o/ /shing brgyad kyi stod kyi yal ga'i bseb na lus phyed 'thon pa'i zhing skyong ba brgyad ni/ shar du glang po che'i gdong pa dkar po/ mi'i gdong pa can ser po/ chu srin gyi gdong pa can dkar po/ ma he'i gdong pa can nag po/ glang gi gdong pa can dkar po/ ra'i gdong pa can dmar po/ ro langs kyi gdong pa can nag po/ ri dwags kyi gdong pa can ljang khu thams cad drag cing gtum la rdzu 'phrul chen po pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas gtor ma dang*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /thugs rje'i chu brgyad/ de la gnas pa'i klu brgyad ni nor rgyas ser po/ 'jog po dmar po/ karko ṭa sngon po/ pad+ma dkar po/ pad+ma chen po dkar po/ mtha' yas sna tshogs mdog rigs ldan dkar po/ dung skyong ser po thams cad kyang stod mi 'dra ba la smad sbrul 'jug g.yas su 'khyil zhing phyag gnyis kyi thal mo sbyar nas gtso bo la 'dud pa'o// de dag gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin chen po brgyad ni/ shar du sgrog pa/ cher sgrog pa/ drag po/ g.yo ba/ brtan pa/ gang ba/ bden bral du 'bebs pa/ rlung du gtum po/ thams cad kyang glog 'phreng g.yo zhing 'brug sgra sgrog pa/ 'ga' zhig char gyi rgyun can kha dog sna tshogs pa'o/ /de na gnas pa'i ri brgyad ni shar du rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi lhun po/

byang du man+ḍa ra ljang khu/ nub tu kai la sha ser po/ lhor ma la ya ser po/ dbang ldan du dbang chen nag po/ mer spos ngad ldan ser po/ bden bral du gangs can dkar po/ rlung du dpal gyi ri sngon po'o/ /ri de rnams la gnas pa'i mchod rten dkar po brgyad dang grub chen brgyad do/ /gzhan yang ye shes kyi me brgyad dang*/ khwa dang*/ 'ug pa dang*/ bya rgod dang*/ lce spyang dang*/ 'ol ba pho mo dang*/ sbrul ba lang gi mgo bo can la sogs pa phyogs su rgyu zhing*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ ro langs dang srin po rnams kyis ki li ki li'i sgra chen po sgrog pa dang*/ grub pa thob pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa dang*| dam tshig spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma bcom ldan 'das la rtse gcig tu blta ba/ gcer bu skra shig pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ cang te'u dang thod pa dang kha ṭaṃ ga 'dzin pa thod pas spyi bor brgyan pa rgod cing khrod du 'jug pa rnams kyis shin tu ngo mtshar bar byed pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi nang gi steng 'og rnams/ shar nag byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus dkar ba 'og gzhi dam tshig 'khor lo la gnas pa'i sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i mu khyud la 'khor lo'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i mu khyud la pad+ma'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i mu khyud la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba| de'i lte bar bde chen gyi 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i mu khyud la gri gug gi phreng bas bskor ba rnams je mtho je mthor gyur pa'i 'khor lo bzhi po re re la mtshams rnams na gnas pa'i ka ba brgyad brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rdo rje'i gdung zlum rim pa bzhi'i thog gis je mtho je mthor gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa'o/ /dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la/

rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog mthing kha zhal bzhi ni/ rtsa zhal mthing kha g.yon zhal ljang*/ rgyab zhal dmar/ g.yas zhal ser ba| zhal re re'ang spyan gsum gsum pa phyag bcu gnyis pa dpral bar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo lag pa bzhi pa'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ lhag ma gnyis kha trāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i nu ma gnan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkums pas 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi pa'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ lhag ma g.yas ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon ral gri 'dzin pa'i mgo bo mnan pa/ gdan gnyis ka'ang gdong gcig pa mig gsum pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o/ /phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa'i g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang g.yon pas dril bu bsnams pa de'i 'og ma gnyis kyi glang po che'i pags pa dkar po khrag dang bcas pa'i na bza' phyag g.yas pas lag pa g.yon pa dang g.yon pas rkang pa g.yon pa'i lpags pa rang gi rgyab tu sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i phyag gis rgyangs te 'dzin pa'i sdig mdzub kyis rtse gnyis sm-in ma'i thad sor gnas pa/ g.yas gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum sgreng ba g.yon gyi phyag gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha trāṃ ga bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje zhags pa drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams shing sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog can dbu re re la rdo rje nag po'i phreng ba stod smad du gnas pa gnyis la rgyus pa'i thod pa skam po lnga lnga'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ dbu'i g.yon du cung zad yo ba'i zla ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ mche ba bzhi bzhi rtsigs zhing 'jigs su rung ba/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa ste sku'i nyams gsum dang*/ rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung ba ste gsung gi nyams gsum dang*/

snying rje dang rngams pa dang zhi ba ste thugs kyi nyams gsum ste gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i shaṃ thabs can mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i phreng ba 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug gis rgyas btab pa mi rus kyi thal bas lus thams cad la byugs pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs par bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum ma gcer mo skra grol ba thod pa'i dum bus brgyan pa'i 'og dpag can/ phyag g.yon pas yab kyi mgul pa nas 'khyud pa'i thod pa na bdud bzhi la sogs pa'i khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa yab kyi zhal du stobs pa g.yas pas phyogs bcu'i bdug pa can kun la rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis sdigs par mdzad pa/ bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi me lta bu/

nyi ma'i 'od can gyi gzi brjid che ba/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ byin pa gnyis kyi yab kyi brla'i steng du legs par 'khril ba thugs rje'i bdag nyid can phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mig mgo skam po lnga'i thod kam dang*/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can no/ /yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa las hūm̐ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ byā dmar po las byung ba'i nor bu dmar po rtse mo byā ser pos mtshan pa yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa las a las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa rgyā dkar po las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems mtshon pa'i lte ba dkar po rtse mo rgyā ser pos mtshan pa yab kyi lte bar zla gdan la oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ thugs kar zla gdan la oṃ sarba bung+ngha ḍā ki ni badz+ra wār+ṇa nā+e ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ mgrin par nyi gdan la oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ḍā ki ni dz+wa la saṃ ba raṃ swāhā dpral bar nyi gdan la oṃ hriḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum gyi lte bar nyi gdan la oṃ shrī badz+ra sogs/ snying khar nyi gdan la oṃ hriḥha sogs/ mgrin par zla gdan la oṃ badz+ra bai ro sogs/ dpral bar zla gdan la oṃ sarba bung+ngha sogs/ swāhā'i sngags thams cad kha dog dmar po g.yon bskor du gnas pa sngags rnams kyang phan tshun zhal sbyor zhing 'od zer 'khyud pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems zhu ba spyi bo nas mgrin par sleb pa na dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying khar sleb pa na mchog dga' snying kha nas lte bar sleb pa na khyad dga'/ lte ba nas nor bu'i rtser sleb pa na lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes skyes pas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyang bde stong dbyer med kyi ngo bor gyur/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/

byang du ma ma ljang khu/ nub tu khaṣ+ta ro he dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig ma/ spyan gsum ma/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i zhal can| gcer mo skra grol ba phyag bzhi pa'i g.yas dang pos gri gug dang*/ g.yon dang pos thod pa bzung nas thugs kar 'khyud pa'i tshul mdzad cing/ g.yas 'og mas ḍā ma ru dang g.yon 'og mas kha trāṃ ga bsnams pa/ cung zad bzhad pa g.yas rkyang gis bzhugs pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can no/ /mtshams bzhir zla gdan la bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi ste bde chen gyi 'khor lo'i/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pu l+li ra ma la yar khaṣ+ta ka pa la dang rab gtum ma/ byang rtsibs dza lan dha rar ma hā kaṃ ka la dang gtum mig ma/ nub rtsibs o tre ya nar kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ lhor rtsibs arnur tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ me rtsibs go da wā rir su ra be ri ṇa dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma bden bral gyi rtsibs ra smi shwa rar 'od dpag med dang khar+wa ri/ rlung rtsibs de wi ko trir rdo rje'i 'od dang lam kha'i dbang phyug ma/ dbang ldan gyi rtsibs ma la war rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams nam mkha' la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs ka ma ru par myu gu can dang sa bsrungs ma/ byang rtsibs o ṭer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub rtsibs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lhor rtsibs ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ me rtsibs ka liṃ kar rab tu bzang po dang sngo sangs lha mo/ bden bral gyi rtsibs lam+pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ rlung rtsibs kañcir 'jigs byed chen mo dang rta sna ma/ dbang ldan gyi rtsibs hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams sa la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po'o/

/sku'i 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang rtsibs gṛ ha de ba tar rin chen rdo rje dang duṃ skyes ma/ nub rtsibs so so raṣ+tar rta mgrin dang chang tshong ma/ lho rtsibs suwar+ṇa di bar nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ me rtsibs na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bden bral gyi rtsibs sin dhur pad+ma gar dbang dang stobs chen ma/ rlung rtsibs ma rung rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ dbang ldan gyi rtsibs ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste sku'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams sa 'og na spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po ste/ dpa' bo nyer bzhi po thams cad kyang zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can dpa' bo'i dar thod dpral bar bcings pa/ phyag bzhi dang po gnyis kyis rdo dril bzung nas yum la 'khyud cing phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru dang g.yon kha trāṃ 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ g.yas brkyangs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /dpa' mo nyer bzhi po thams cad kyang zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum ma/ yab la 'khyud pa'i phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas bdug pa la sdig pa'i sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i gri gug 'dzin cing*| g.yon pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin cing stob pa drag mo'i gzugs can gcer mo skra grol bas rnam par mdzes shing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skaṃ lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can 'og dpag sil sil gyi sgra sgrog pa'o// shar sgor kha gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lhor sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/

nub byang du gshin rje mche ba mo g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang drag mo chen mo sems can kun gyi don mdzad pa la brtson pa zhal gcig ma sogs snying po'i rnal 'byor ma ji bzhin la cung zad bzhad pa'i gnas su ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa ces dang*/ thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can/ 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi dpral bar rdo rje'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o| | gsum pa ni/ byang phyogs so bdun lha dang sbyar ba ste/ 'di bsgom pa'i dgos pa ni/ 'grel pa gsum las lha'i rnam pa la mngon zhen 'dor ba dang thams cad shes pa nyid thob par bya ba'i phyir du bsgom pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'bras bu'i skabs na gnyis med bde chen gyi ye shes nyid lhar shar ba yin la/ de dang rjes su mthun par 'bras bu lam du byed pa'i don yin gyi/ byang phyogs so bdun po theg chen gzhan dang thun mong ba nyid lhar ston pa ni ma yin no/ /des na de'i tshul ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas bzhi dang gsang gnas byin gyis brlab pa'i yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems zhu ba spyi bo nas mgrin par sleb pa na dga' ba ces sogs nas lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes skyes pas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyang bde stong dbyer med kyi ngo bor gyur cing de ltar bde stong dbyer med du sbyar ba de nyid byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos so bdun gyi ngo bo lha so bdun du shar ba ni/ lus tshor sems chos dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ /mkha' 'gro la ma duṃ skyes gzugs can ma// 'dun brtson dpyod sems rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi/ /rab gtum gtum mig 'od ldan sna chen ma/ /dad rtson dran dang ting 'dzin shes rab kyi/ /dbang po lnga ni dpa' bo'i slo can ma/ /mi thung lang dbang shing grib sa bsrungs ma/ /stobs lnga 'jigs byed chen mo rlung shugs dang*/

/chang 'thung sngo sangs rab tu bzang mo'o// ting 'dzin brtson 'grus dga' dang shin sbyangs 'byed/ /dran dang btang snyoms byang chub yan lag bdun/ /rta sna bya gdong 'khor lo'i shugs can dang*/ /duṃ skyes chang tshong go cha rab dpal mo/ /yang dag lta rtog ngag dang las mtha' 'tshol| |rtsol dran rnams ni stobs chen 'khor sgyur ma/ /brtson chen kha gdong 'ug gdong khyi phag gdong*/ /yang dag ting 'dzin he ru ka dpal ste/ /dge ba skyed spel sdig pa mi skyed spong*/ /yang dag spong bzhi gshin rje brtan ma dang*/ / pho nya mo dang mche ba 'joms pa'o/ /zhes brjod na tshegs chung zhing dgos pa che ba'o| | gsum pa la gnyis las dang po lus dkyil gsal gdab pa ni/ lus kyi cha rags pa dang*/ phra ba rtsa dang khams rnams rten dang brten pa'i lus dkyil du bsgoms pas/ rim pa/ gnyis par lus la gnad du snun pa las rdzogs rim gyi rtog pa skye ba'i smin byed du dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlob pa yin la/ de yang sngon byang lnga las gcig char grub zin yang rim gyis gsal 'debs pa ste/ de ni rkang pa gnyis bsgrad pa gzhu'i dbyibs su yod pa ni 'byung ba rim rtsegs kyi rlung gzhu'i dbyibs can/ sum mdo gru gsum gyi gzugs ni me dkyil gru gsum/ lto ba zlum po'i dbyibs can ni chu dkyil zlum po/ snying kha gru bzhi'i dbyibs ni sa dkyil gru bzhi/ rgal tshigs ni ri rab spyi bo'i rtsa so gnyis ni pad+ma lus 'dom gang yas mas dang phan tshun mnyam pa ni ngos bzhi mnyam pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pha gu dang dra phyed sogs kyis rab tu mdzes pa'i he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor bsrung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum ni 'khor lo gsum mo/ /snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus kyi khams khyad par can dang rtsa'i gtso mo bde mchog yab yum du bzhugs pa ni/

dpal he ru ka zhes dang*/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dang g.yon brkum pas 'jigs byed gnan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi sogs nas do shal can no/ /snying kha'i shar la sogs pa'i 'byung ba bzhi rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa bzhi ni snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi ste/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo sogs/ shar lho la sogs pa mchod pa'i rtsa bzhi ni bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi ste bde chen gyi 'khor lo'o/ /spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyer bzhi po/ pu dza o a go ra de ma ka o tri ko ka la ka hi/ pre gṛ so pū na si ma ku rnams kyi rnam par gnas pa ni/ rtsibs khong stong rtsibs shun gyi rnam pa can gyi phyi'i yul nyer bzhi'i rang bzhin no/ /de rnams la gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa rnams dpa' bo/ nyer bzhi yum du gsal ba ni skra mtshams pul+li ra ma la yar khan+ṭa ka pa la dang rab gtum ma spyi gtsug dza lan dha rar ma hā k-i ka la dang gtum mig ma rna ba g.yas pa o ḍi ya nar k-i ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag pa ur+wu ltar mche ba rnam par brtsegs pa dang sna chen ma ste gnas so/ /de bzhin du gnas dang lha'i ming sbyar la/ rna ba g.yon pa smin mtshams| mig gnyis phrag pa gnyis rnams nye ba'i gnas ste thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams so so/ /mchan khung gnyis/ nu ma gnyis/ zhing*/ lte ba/ sna rtse nye ba'i zhing/ kha/ mgrin gnyis tshan dho ha/ snying*/ 'bras bu gnyis rnams nye ba'i tshan dho ha ste gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams sa la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs so| |mtshan ma pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma bshang lam| 'du ba/ brla gnyis/ byin pa gnyis rnams 'du ba ser mo bcu drug bol gong gnyis rnams dur khrod/ /mthe bong bzhi pus mo gnyis nye ba'i dur khrod ste sku'i 'khor lo'i sogs so/ /dpa' bo nyer bzhi po thams cad kyang ces pa nas 'og dpag sil sil gyi sgra sgrog pa'o/

/lce'i rtsa bar gnas pa'i rtsa ni kha gdong ma nag mo lte ba'i bug pa na gnas pa'i rtsa ni 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ ltag kyi sgor gnas pa'i rtsa ni khyi gdong ma/ bshang lam gyi sgor gnas pa'i rtsa ni phag gdong ma/ mdzod spu'i bug pa na gnas pa'i rtsa ni gshin rje brtan ma/ rna ba'i bug pa gnyis na gnas pa'i rtsa ni gshin rje pho nya mo/ mig gnyis na gnas pa'i rtsa ni gshin rje mche ba ma/ sna bug gnyis na gnas pa'i rtsa ni gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang drag mo chen mo zhes sogs nas/ dpral bar rdo rje phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ / gnyis pa go cha ni/ sa bon las skyes pa sogs ni mi dgos par rang gi snying khar rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje ḍā ma ru mgo bo/ g.yon dril bu thod pa kha trāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rdo rje phag mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ mgo bor rnam snang ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon dril bu dang thod pa bcas pa'i kha trāṃ ga 'dzin pa gshin rje ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba spyi gtsug tu pad+ma gar dbang dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ḍā ma ru g.yon gnyis dril bu sogs/ rmongs byed ma/ phrag pa gnyis su dpal he ru ka nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas rdo rje dang ḍā ma ru g.yon gnyis sogs/ bskyod byed ma mig gnyis su rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis rin po che dang ḍā ma ru g.yon sogs/ skrag byed ma dang*/ dpral bar yan lag thams cad kyi lus dbang gi rang bzhin rta mchog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis ral gri dang ḍā ma ru g.yon gnyis sogs/ tsan+ṭika dang*| mnyam par sbyor ba rdo rje sems dpa' zla gdan la bzhugs shing zla ba'i 'od bskor can/ gzhan lnga ni nyi gdan la bzhugs shing nyi ma'i 'od bskor can/ dpa' bo drug po thams cad phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/

thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*| thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can dang stag gi lpags pa'i shaṃ thabs can/ spyan gsum pa g.yas rkyang gis bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso mo'i lte bar rdo rje phag mo dmar mo dmar sngo ljang ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis g.yas gri gug gis tshangs mgo lcags kyu g.yon thod pa kha trāṃ ga zhags pa 'dzin pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang mnyam par sbyor ba snying gar gshin rje ma sngon mo rnam snang dang*/ mgrin par rmongs byed ma dkar mo pad+ma gar dbang dang*/ mgo bor bskyod byed ma ser mo dpal he ru ka dang*/ spyi gtsug tu skrag byed ma ljang khu rdo rje nyi ma dang dpral bar yan lag thams cad kyi lus dbang gi rang bzhin tsan+ṭi ka dud kha rta mchog dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas gnyis ḍā ma ru dang gri gug dang g.yon gnyis thod pa dang bcas pa'i kha trāṃ ga dril bu 'dzin pa/ rmongs byed ma zla gdan la bzhugs shing 'od bskor can/ gzhan lnga ni nyi gdan la bzhugs shing nyi ma'i 'od can/ thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa gcer mo skra grol ba phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can g.yas rkyang gis bzhugs pa'o/ / lnga pa la gnyis las dang po ye shes pa bzhugs pa ni/ pheṃ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar nyi gdan la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo ye shes pa'i 'khor los gyur pa dbang gi lha dkyil 'khor pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs 'od zer rang gi snying khar thim/ dbang gi lha mo rnams ni ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dang ḍā ma ru 'dzin pa/ oṃ badz+ra bi ni sogs rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ| oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+d+re hoḥ/

zhes pa rnams kyi dgug bzhug bcing mnyes par byas rten rnams la yang 'od 'phreng dang dur khrod la sogs pa'i bar du stim mo/ /oṃ yo ga shung+nghaḥ sarba dharmaḥ yo ga shung+ngho?& haṃ/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa ro mnyam du sbyar ba ni/ chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid dang bde ba chen po'i ye shes gnyis ngo bo dbyer med yin la de nyid rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du shar ba yin zhing de yang gtso bo yab yum du shar ba'i cha shas so/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba bī ra sogs sngar gyi skad cig ma'i sngags so/ /

gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni de nas dbang lha rnams la rig ma bcu drug gis mchod la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs skrad/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis par brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum bzhi phag mo dang bcas pas phyag g.yon pa'i thod pa cung zad yo par bya ste/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha'i chu ni dag pa yis| |de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas| rang dang lha rnams bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid du gyur/ spyi bo nas sku la zhugs pa'i chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las gtso bo la mi skyod pa/ phag mo la rnam snang*/ mkha' 'gro ma sogs bzhi la rin 'byung thugs 'khor gyi lha rnams la mi skyod pa/ gsung 'khor la snang mtha'/ sku 'khor la rnam snang*/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams la don grub kyis dbu brgyan cing des bum pa'i dbang thob/ de nas snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi phag mo la thims nas de dang he ru ka snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems lce la bzhag pa myangs pa las gsang ba'i dbang thob/ de nas he ru kas phag mo phyag rgya snang ba la snyoms par zhugs pas/ rlung thims pa las lhan skyes kyi dga' ba myong ba las shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ de nas he ru kas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi phyag rgya dang sbyar ba la rten nas thob pa'i ye shes te/ 'od gsal bar bsgoms shig 'od gsal de ni snang mched thob gsum gyi rnam shes rnam par dag pa sher phyin gyi ngo bo yin la/ don dam pa'i bden pa de ni mthong ba gzhan gyi yul las 'das pa ste/

shes rab dang ye shes kyi mig gis ltos shig de ltar gzhan gang gi yang rang bzhin du ma mthong ba de ni 'od gsal mthong ba yin no/ de'i ngo na rgyu 'bras gang yang med mod kyi/ 'on kyang kun rdzob du rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i lha so bdun gzugs brnyan ltar gsal la rdzogs pa/ 'ja' tshon ltar kha dog ma 'dres par so sor snang ba/ chu zla ltar sgro bskur dang bral bar ltos shig de 'dra ba'i kun rdzob dang don dam 'od gsal gnyis dbyer mi phyed par zung du 'jug pa ni byang chub kyi sems chen po ste dbang bzhi pa'o zhes don gyi dbang bzhi pa bstan pa'i don go ba las tshig gi sgo nas dbang bzhi pa thob/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang rang la thims par gyur zhes brjod do/ / drug pa la mchod bstod dang dag pa gnyis las dang po ni/ thog mar sngags mchod kyi sgo nas lha gsal gdab par bya ste/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dz+wa la saṃ ba raṃ swāhā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ sarba bung+ngha ḍā ki ni badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ḍā ki ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ la me hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+d+ra ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ka ra ka ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pra tsaṇ+d+ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ o ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇ+d+ri ak+ṣi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du kun la mgo bor oṃ dang mthar hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar la/ ban+dha ban+dha/ pra bha wa ri / trā sa ya trā sa ya/ mahā na se/ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya/ wī ra ma ti| hroṃ hroṃ/ kharba ṛ/ hrāḥhrāḥ laṅge shwa ri/ pheṃ pheṃ/ dru mats+tsha ye/ phaṭa phaṭa/ e ra wa ta ི | da ha da ha/ mahā bheṃ ra bī/ pa tsa pa tsa/ wa yu be ge bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣa ba sa ru dhi ran+t+ra mā la ba lam+bini/ su ra bhak+ṣi*/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sap+ta pā ta la ga ta bhu dzaṃ gaṃ sarbaṃ ba tardza ya tardza ya/

sh+yā ma de bī/ ā kang+ngh+ye ākang+ngh+ye/ su bha tre/ hriṃ hriṃ/ ha ya kar+ṇe/ dz+nyauṃ dz+nyauṃ/ kha gā na ne/ k+ṣ+maṃk+ṣ+maṃ/ tsakra be ge/ haṃ haṃ/ khan+ṭaro he/ hīṃ hīṃ*/ shoṇ+ḍi ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ tsa kra warmi ṇi/ ki li ki li/ su bīri/ si li si li/ mahā ba le/ he li hi li/ tsakra brti ni| dhi li dhi li/ ma hā bit+ye/ ka kā s+ye/ ū lu kā s+ye/ shwa nā s+ye/ shwa ka rā s+ye/ ya ma dā dhi/ ya ma dū ti/ ya ma daṃṣ+t+ya ṇe/ ya ma ma tha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ bha ra maṇ+ḍa la sarba wī ra yo gi ni ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ nyer spyod rol mo rnams la sbyar nas dbul/ rig ma bcu drug gis kyang mchod de/ /phyi'i mchod pa'o/ / de nas nang mchod byin gyis brlabs pa yod na de'am med na 'dir byin gyis brlab nas/ thog mar bla ma rnams la dbul ste/ mgron rnams kyi ljags la hūm̐ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dkar po nas 'bru tsam 'khod*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha traṃ a khaṃ hūm̐/ lha mor ro rdo rje mas bdud rtsi bltabs pa rdo rje'i 'od zer gyis sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod bstod phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa bka' drin can rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi rgyal sras phyag na rdo rje/ dpal ldan sa ra ha pa/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ grub chen sha ba ri pa/ dbang phyug lu i pa/ rgyal po dā ri ka pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ grub chen rus sbal zhabs/ shrī dza lan+dha ra/ grub chen nag po spyod pa/ dpal ldan gu h+ya pa/ rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs can/

grub chen te lo pa/ paṇa chen nā ro pa/ phaṃ 'thing pa sku mched/ klog skya shes rab rtsegs/ mal gyo blo gros grags/ sa chen kun snying*/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya pan+ṭi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ nam bza' brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ lo chen skyabs mchog mtshan can/ sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' mtshan can no nye brgyud ni dpal ldan 'khor lo bsdom pa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī paṇa chen bi bu ti tsan+ṭa g.yag sde lo tsā ba mnga' ris pa sangs rgyas ye shes kun mkhyen bu ston chos rje/ thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang*/ sems pa chen po nam mkha'i mtshan can no/ slar yang*/ sa paṇa/ lo ts+tsha ba bsod nams seng ge sangs rgyas 'bum me lo ts+tsha ba mchog ldan| bla ma dpal ldan seng ge kun mkhyen bu ston chos rje thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang/ sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' 'od zer/ chos kyi rgyal po stag tshang pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phag mo grub chen lo hi pa/ ri khrod zhabs*/ ghaṣ+ta pa/ 'dren mdzad zhabs/ be khya ta de wa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ g.yag sde lo ts+tsha ba bsod nams seng ge zi dmar ba sangs rgyas ye shes/ kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che man chad gong bzhin/ kha che lugs kyi gsan yig bzhin bkod pa lags/ /gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag nos pa'i bla ma daṃ pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi de nas yid daṃ la'ang rang rang gi mtshan sngags kyis dbul ste/ shrī he ru ka oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du badz+ra wa ra hi/ ḍā ki ni sogs snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang*/ de nas 'khor lo gsum gyi dpa' mo'i mtshan sngags ni gong du brjod zin la/ dpa' bo rnams la khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ma hā kaṃ ka la/ kad+ga la/ bi ka ṭa daṃṣ+taṇa/ su ra bai ri ṇa/

a mi ta bhā/ badz+ra pra bha/ badz+ra de ha/ aṅku ri ka badz+ra dza ṭa la/ mahā bī ra| badz+ra hūm̐ kā ra/ subha tra/ badz+ra bha dra/ mahā bhai ra ba/ bi ru pa ak+ṣi/ ma hā ba la| rat+na badz+ra/ ha ya gri ba/ a ka sha gar+bha shrī he ru ka pad+ma n+ya t+ya shwa ra/ bai ro tsa na| badz+ra satwa sogs dang*/ dpa' mo rnams kyi mtshan spel nas dbul/ oṃ ka kā s+ye sogs mtshams ma brgyad dang*/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yid dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi/ gzhan yang chos skyong*| gnas gsum mkha' 'gro/ dur khrod brgyad sogs na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong zhing skyong gzhi bdag sogs dang*/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can lhar gyur pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ a mṛ ta swa da na swa bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ mgron thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis tshims par gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi thod pa nas byung ba'i bdud rtsi lngas kyang lha rnams la mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba badz+ra kā mi ni sarba bha k+ṣaṃ shong+ngha ya gu he badz+ra ṇi swāhā de rnams ni nang mchod do/ /de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gnas bzhi dang gsang gnas byin gyis brlabs pa'i yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems zhu ba spyi bo nas zhes sogs nas nor bu'i rtser sleb pa na lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes skyes pas lha thams cad kyis kyang bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur par bsam pa ni gsang ba'i mchod pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor pa'i lha thams cad kyis kyang lhan skyes kyi bde ba dang de kho na nyid dbyer med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pas de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mnyes par bsam pa ni de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o/ /de nas oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī ri shwa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ mahā kalpa ag+ni sin+na bha ya/ oṃ dza ṭa mu ku ṭod ka ṭāya/ oṃ daṃṣ+ta ka ra lo gra bhī ṣa na mu khā ya/ oṃ sa ha pra bhu dza bhā su rā ya/ oṃ pa ra shu pā shod+yā ta shu la kha ṭāṃ ga dha ri ṇe/ oṃ byāgra a dzi na aṃ wa ra dha rā ya/ oṃ ma hā dhuṃm+m+ra an+dha ka ra wa su ṣā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas 'og nas 'chad pa'i yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis kyang bstod par bya te bstod pa'o/ /de nas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor la gsal snang ston la legs par brtan par bya zhing zab gsal gnyis med kyi lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par bya ste bslob tshul rgyas par gzhan du bshad pa la bslab par bya'o/ / gnyis pa dag pa la yang gsum las/ dang po rten gyi dag pa ni/ thams cad dngos po gcig nyid du/ /sprul sku'i mdzad pa rdzogs gyur pa/ /dur khrod yin ste lus su dag /ye shes snang bas kun khyab cing*/ /bdud bcom 'od dang rdo rjer ldan/ /mi mnyam med pas zur bzhi pa/ /'phags pa'i bden bzhi ngos bzhi nyid/ /dran dang dbang po sgo bzhi yin/ /bsam gtan bzhi yis rta babs te/ /tshon sna lnga po sangs rgyas nyid/ /dge ba'i spyod pas kra shiraṣa/ /dra tshogs byang chub yan lag bdun/ /ba dan dril bu gsung rab sgra/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi kha khyer te/ /gzungs ni mchod pa'i lha mo'o/ /pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos te| |gcod byed 'khor lo rnams yin no/ /ye shes thugs dang gsung dang sku'i/ /'khor lo bskor ba phreng ba bzhin/ /rnam thar brgyad kyis ka ba ste/ /sna tshogs chos 'khor rgyal po'i gnas/ /'khor lo gdugs kyi rnam pas mdzes// chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig phyir/ /rtse mor rdo rjes brgyan pa nyid/ / gnyis pa lha'i rnam dag ni/ /byams thugs chos nyid 'gyur med skug mdog nag /stong nyid 'gro kun zil gnon gzi 'od 'bar/ /yab yum phan tshun 'khyud pas thabs shes sbyor/ /zhal bzhi rnam thar sgo bzhi stong pa nyid/

/ bcu gnyis phyag ni rten 'brel bcu gnyis 'gog /g.yas rkyang ro gdan rtag chad srid zhi gnon/ /stag dang glang lpags bdud bcom gti mug dral/ /mgo phreng ā li kā li'i thabs shes sbyor/ /zla phyed thal ba byang sems lus kun khyab| |de'i bde ba kha trāṃ thod pas mtshan/ /rdor dril ye shes lnga dang sher phyin don| |phyag mtshan lhag ma sangs rgyas thams cad bskul/ /sgo gsum skyon dang mthar 'dzin rnam rtog gcod/ /nyon mongs 'bigs shing yang dag ye shes 'ching*| |skyon zad spangs pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo ste/ /zhi mtha' spangs pa'i gzugs sku thod skam yin/ /de yis de nyid gzigs phyir spyan gsum ldan// zhal 'gyur log lta kun las log pa ste/ /bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i mche ba gtsigs pa'o/ /ral pa gyen rdzais yon tan gong du 'phel/ /de mthar ye shes lngar gnas rdo rje'i phreng*/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'phrin las rnam bzhi rgyas/ /phyag rgya drug ldan phyin drug lam mthar phyin/ /gar dgu zhi lhag nyams kun rdzogs pa'o/ /rdo rjes gdug pa kun sdigs bdud bzhi'i khrag /skra grol chos kyi dbyings las ye shes bskyed/ /gcer mo bdud bral dmar zhing gzi 'bar ba// 'gro ba kun chags mnyam par rtogs pa'o/ /gsum pa rgyan sogs kyi dag pa ni/ dpa' bo rtsa ba'i sngags sogs gang*/ /tshangs pa'i skud pa sogs su btags// dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yi/ /lus kyi khaṃs la btags pa yin/ /dpa' bo go cha drug po yis/ /phyag rgya 'di ni lus mdzes so/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sngags gang yin// mgrin par 'gur chus brgyan pa'o/ /lha'i snying po'i sngags kyi ni/ /phreng ba brgya yi phyed kyis brgyan/ /yi ge bdun pa'i gsang sngags kyis/ /gdub skor gyis ni rna ba brgyan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro mas/ /lpags pa'i gos mchog 'dzin pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma drug gsang sngags kyis/ /skye rags byas pas brgyan pa'o/

/'khor lo kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /sngags kyi btung ba'i thod pa'o| |bai ro tsa na'i sngags gang yin/ /dpral bar thod pas brgyan pa'o/ / 'dzam gling gnas mchog nyi shu bzhi/ /lus la rdzogs par gnas pa ste/ /der gnas dpa' bo dpa' mo kun/ /lus kyi khams dang rtsar dag go kha trāṃ ga ni lha yi sku/ /shes rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ /nyin mo bcom ldan dpa' bo chen/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mtshan mor bshad/ /mya ngan 'das 'byung dpa' bo ni/ /drug pa chos kyi sprul pa ste/ /dag pa sems kyi sprul pa ni/ /phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa yin| |shrī ni gnyis med ye shes ste/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni bkod dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing bsgom mo/ / lū hi pa'i 'grel pa rnams nas phyogs mthun so bdun dang sbyor pa sogs mkhyen gsum bsdu ba dang*/ de phar phyin gyi lam thams cad 'dir 'du ba sogs ni gzhan du gsal bas 'dir ma spros so/ bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po ni dbyangs gsal ngag tu brjod cing*/ de'i tshe dbyangs gsal gyi phreng ba 'od zer lnga ldan 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs 'phro ba sna bug g.yas pa'i rlung dang 'grogs nas 'phros pas/ 'gro ba rnams 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs su byas/ byas pa de rnams thog ma med pa nas grub pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dang ro mnyam du gyur pa/ sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te lte bar gnas pa dbyangs gsal gyi gzugs brnyan dang ldan pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can du gyur par bsgoms de'i dbus su skad cig gis hūm̐ yig dkar dmar de dang zla ba gnyis yongs su gyur pa las he ru ka dkar po g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdor dril bsnams pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang snyoms par zhugs pas/

gsang gnas gnyis bskyod pa'i sgyu ma'i dga' ba'i sgras 'gro ba rnams bkug ste/ dur khrod la thims de rten gyi 'khor lo sgo mtshams ma dang bcas pa sku 'khor la de gsung 'khor la de thugs 'khor la thims/ de'i shar nas g.yon bskor gyis phyogs nas gnas pa bzhi ni rim bzhin du mkha' 'gro ma nas bzung ste g.yon bskor gyis lha mo bzhi la thims/ me nas brtsams ste mtshams na gnas pa bzhi ni gzugs can ma nas bzung ste/ g.yas bskor gyi lha mo bzhi la thims/ thod pa bzhi yang gzugs can ma sogs bzhi la bsdu/ lha mo bzhi yang rang ngos kyi gtso bo'i zhal gcig la rim pa bzhin du thims/ dam tshig pa yab yum lte ba'i ye shes sems pa yab yum la thims de gnyis kyang snyoms par zhugs pas zhu bar gyur/ zhu ba de yongs su gyur pa las/ sidhun ras byugs pa'i mu tig lta bu'i hūm̐ yig bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu u ni ha la sogs nas/ nā da yang skra'i rtse mo brgya stong gi cha'i tshad tsam du byas pa la sems bzung ngo*/ /rab kyi ni de yang mi dmigs par*/ 'od gsal du bsdus pa la sems nus tshad bzung ngo*/ /'di la mkhas pa dag rdzogs rim bzhed mod/ rdzogs rim dang 'brel ba la dgongs kyi rdzogs rim dngos min no/ /de nas bsgom pas skyo bar gyur na/ sngar gyi skad cig ma'i sngags brjod la stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal la yongs su rdzogs par gyur zhes brjod do/

/ gsum pa la 'jug pa gnyis/ thun gyi ngo bo dang 'brel ba dang*/ thun mtshams gzhan dang 'brel ba'o/ /dang po ngo bo dang 'brel ba la yang gsum las| dang po bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rdo bzlas skabs 'dir gsungs yang rdzogs rim 'chad pa la shes par bya la/ 'dir bzlas bya'i sngags ni rtsa rgyud las sa steng g-i rin chen bzhi/ /phreng ba'i gnas ni dam pa yin/ /zhes yab yum gyi rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ nye snying dang*/ go cha'i sngags te rin chen bzhi'i sngags dang*/ phreng sngags mchog tu gsungs so/ /de la rtsa sngags sam phreng sngags la gnyis yod pa'i yab kyi sngags ni ka ra ka ra la sogs pa sngags tshan pa nyer bzhi ma bcad par phyogs gcig tu sbrel ste mgo bor oṃ dang mthar hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar ba'o/ /yum gyi phreng sngags la mi 'dra ba mang du yod kyang 'khrul spong sogs rgya gzhung 'ga' zhig las ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra wā rwa hī baṃ/ ār+ya a pa ra dzi te lo kya mā te bi te bid+yeshwa ri/ sarba bhu ta bha ya a ba he ma hā badz+re/ badz+ra ā pa ni a pa ra dzi te wa shaṃ ka ri nai tra/ bh+ra ma ṇi bi ṣa ṇi sho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ka ra li ni/ trā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe dha ni pa ra dza ye/ bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo ha ni/ badz+ra bā rā hi ma hā yo gī ni kā me shwa ri kha ge tad+ya thā/ pro tad+ge pro taṅge ha na ha na pra ṇaṃ kiṃ ki ni khiṃ khi ni/ dhu na dhu na badz+ra haste/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ badz+ra kha ṭāṃ ga ka pa la/ dha ri ṇi/ ma hā pi shi ta māṃ pā sa ni/ ma nu ṣ+yan+t+ra a tra bi te sa ni dh+ya na ra shi ra ma la gran+thi ta/ dha ri ṇi/ sum+bha ni sum+bha ha na ha na pra ṇaṃ/ sarba pra sha bā naṃ/ ma hā man+sa ts+tshe da ni/ kro dha mut+te daṃṣ+ta ka rā li ni ma hā mu tre shrī he ru ka de ba se agra ma hi ṣī sa ha pri shi re sa ha pra nā ha be/ sha ta sa ha prā na ne/ dz+wa li ta te dza se/ dz+wa li mu khe/

peṃ ga la lo tsa ne/ badz+ra shā rī ro badz+ra ā sa ni/ mi li te tsi li te/ he he/ hūm̐ hūm̐| kha kha/ dhu dhu/ dhu ru dhu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ a dwe te/ ma hā yo gi ni/ pa ṭhī ta sid+dhe/ treṃdhaṃ treṃ dhaṃ/ graṃ graṃ/ he he/ ha ha/ bhi me ha sa ha sa bī re/ hā hā/ he he/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ trai lo kya bi nā shā ni sha ta sa ha pra ko ṭi/ ta thā ga ta pa ri shwa re hūm̐ hūm̐/ seṃ ha ru pe khaḥ ga tsa ru pe āḥ trai lo kya u da re sa mu dra me kha le gra sa gra sa hūm̐hūm̐ phaṭa/ bī ra a dwe te hūm̐ hūm̐/ ha ha ma hā pa shu mo ha ni yo gi ni shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ ḍā ki ni lo kā ni/ ban+dha nāṃ sat+ya pra t+yā ya ka ri ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhū ta trā sa ni ma hā bī ra pa ra ma sang+ngh-i yo gi shwa ri phaṭa| hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes stod du yum gi rkang brgyad dang bcas pa gcig bshad| mngon brjod kyi nyi shu pa dang*/ phag mo mngon 'byung las rkang brgyad dang tad+ya thā med par oṃ badz+ra wa ri hī pro tad+ge nas yo gi shwa ri phaṭa kyi bar la 'ga' yar ma gtogs pa sngar dang 'dra la mthar hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces 'byung bas rkang brgyad yod med gnyis yod do/ /snying po dang nye snying sngar bshad la/ go cha la oṃ ha sogs drug gi thog mar oṃ dang mthar hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar ba dang*/ badz+ra satwa sogs mtshan sngags drug la sngar bzhin sbyar ba gnyis bshad do/ /dpa' bo nyer bzhi'i sngags la rang rang gi mtshan sngags yod pa dang med pa gnyis kyi dang po ni| lū hi pas mdzad pa sngar bshad zin pa lta bu'o/ /mtshan sngags yod pa la mtshan sngags rkyang pa'i thog mthar sngar bzhin sbyar ba dang*/ rtsa sngags nyer bzhir bcas pa dang*/ spel ba gnyis kyi phyi ma la thog mtha' bar du spel tshul gsum gsungs so/ /dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i mtshan sngags sbrel ba yang bshad la| lha mo gzhan bcu gnyis kyi sngags ni sngar ltar ro/ /gzhan yang lha drug cu'i sngags shin tu bsdus pa byed na oṃ hūm̐ baṃ ṛṃ riṃ l̥ṃ l̥ṃ/

kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ngaṃ*/ tsaṃ tshaṃ dzaṃ dzhaṃ nyaṃ| ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ dhaṃ ṇaṃ/ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ/ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ/ yaṃ raṃ laṃ waṃshaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ k+ṣaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa| ces sbyar ba mngon spyod las bshad de/ /sa bon so drug sbrel nas thog mthar sngar bzhin sbyar yang chog la/ bgrang phreng ni las so so dang mthun pa dang*| 'dir gtso bor mi rus kyi phreng ba'am/ bo te tsi la sogs pa 'phreng thag gzhon nu ma ma nyams pas bkal ba'i ras bal gyi skud pa las byas pa bsangs sbyangs te phreng ba'i bskyed chog rgyas pa'am de ma grub na skad cig gis gsung rdo rje pad+ma gar dbang du bskyed/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dang gcig tu bya/ bum chus gtor la mchod nas/ oṃ pad+ma nre t+ye shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'am swāhā/ hu'i thog mthar sngar bzhin sbyar la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te gsung rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las phreng ba'i rnam par bsams la/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bzung ste| gtso bo'i snying po dang nye snying bzlo na/ rang gi lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dkar dmar nā da rkyang pa dkar dmar ltas la/ de la bzlas bya'i sngags kyis 'khor bar dmigs te/ dbus kyi yi ge la 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas/ slar bsdud pa'i tshe dbus kyi yi ge la bsdud pa'i tshul gyis bzlo la/ yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying dang*/ lha gzhan rnams kyi sngags bzlo na| rang rang gi thugs ka'i nyi gdan la/ ting nge 'dzin sems pa'i hūm̐ yig dgod pa de la bzlas bya'i sngags kyis 'khor bar dmigs nas/ sngar bzhin spro bsdu'i tshul gyis bzlo ste dam tshig gi bzlas pa'o/ /yab yum gyi phreng sngags bzlo ba'i tshe/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi nga rgyal gyis/ sngags phreng rang gi zhal nas zhugs te/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar zhugs/ de'i dhu ti'i lam nas steng du byung ste/ gtso mo'i zhal nas thon nas/

rang gi zhal du zhugs shing nā dar thims pa dang yang sngar bzhin 'khor bar bsgom nas bzlas te/ khros pa'i bzlas pa'o/ /sems ma yengs pa la 'bad nas bzla bar bya ste/ de yang bzlas pa'i skyon/ ha cang sgra che ba dang*/ ring thung gi tshad las nyams pa dang*| de gnyis bzlog nas 'don pa sogs dang bral bar bzla zhing*/ mthe bong lcags kyu ltar byas la lha rnams 'gugs pa'i tshul gyis bzla'o/ /'di la yang nges don gyi bzlas pa dang drang don gyi bzlas pa gnyis ka yod la/ de yang thun gyi ngo la ma yengs par bzlas pa rnams grangs su bzhugs su bzhug gi thun bar du bzlas pa rnams dang*/ sems g.yengs nas bzlas pa sogs ni/ grangs la mi phan yang bzla bar bshad do/ /gzhan la dbang bskur ba dang*/ rang nyid bdag 'jug byed pa dang*/ rab gnas sogs la dbang ba la/ sngon du bsnyen pa gal che la/ de la gnyis las rgyas pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum la khri phrag gsum gsum| 'khor lo gsum gyi lha re re la khri phrag gnyis gnyis/ lha mo gzhan bcu gnyis po re re la stong phrag phyed dang drug re bzla bar bshad do/ /'bring dang bsdus pa ni/ gtso bo la 'bum dang*/ 'khor la khri phrag re re/ rgyas bsdus gnyis ka la thun mong du ye shes pa'i sngags khri phrag gcig bzla ste/ gtso bo'i sngags ni snying po'i sngags su gsungs te des gzhan yang mtshon la de rnams ni grangs kyi bsnyen pa'i tshad yin la/ dus kyi ni zla ba drug du gzhan dang ma 'dres par chig dril bya ste/ mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa ni phyi nang gi mtshan ma khyad par can byung gi bar du'o/ / gnyis pa gtor ma ni/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma sha dang chang la sogs pa dang ldan pa bshams nas/ gong gi nang mchod byin rlabs ltar byin gyis rlab bo/ /gtor mgron ni sngar bshad pa ltar gyi 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang sngags kyis dur khrod na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong sogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la spyan drangs ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/
