de nas lag pa gnyis ā li kā li yongs su gyur pa las zla ba dang nyi ma'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i dbus su hūm̐ yig oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharma spa ra spa ra a nu prabiṣ+ta sarba dharma/ a d+yan+ta ta a nu pra biṣ+ta sarba dharma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod sngon du 'gro bas/ zla nyi hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje thal mor byas pa'i lag mthil du gtor ma'i snod dngos su bzhag pa'am/ bzhag par mos te/ de nas gtor 'gron gyis gtor ma bdag gir mdzad pa'i phyir du/ rang gi 'dod don brjod de/ /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ /des brjod gsung yang mchog tu tshad ma ste/ /bden pa 'di dag gis ni lha mo rnams/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cigamachod pa'i 'khor gsum po thams cad bde stong dbyer med ngo bor gyur cing mgron rnams kyi ljags la hūm̐ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dkar po nas 'bru tsam 'khod pa'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur par bsam zhing oṃ āḥbadz+ra a ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya staṃ tri sh+ya hoḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas gtso bo dang gtso mo shar nas g.yon bskor gyis mkha' 'gro ma so bzhi la 'bul/ rtsa sngags lan gcig brjod pas 'khor lo gsum gyi g.yon lha la bskor ba dang*/ yang rtsa sngags lan gcig gis g.yas bskor du gnas pa la dbul zhing*/ sngags snga ma lan gcig gi sgo ma bzhi dang*/ sngags de lan gcig gis mtshams ma bzhi la dbul zhing rig ma bcu drug gis mchod rkang brgyad kyis bstod la/ srid pa dang mnyam zhi ba'i chags bcom kun tu rtog pa bcom/ khyod ni dngos po mtha' dag ltar gzigs pa dang ldan pa/ /mgon po shin tu brtse ba lci ba'i chus rlan thugs kyi chus// mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis bdag la shin tu rjes brtser mdzod/ /ces sogs 'dod don la gsol ba gdab bo/

/de nas spyan drangs pa ni dur khrod na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong dang klu la sogs pa skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug pa las bde mchog yab yum gyi skur bzhengs pa'i zhes sogs nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar sngon 'gro'i gtor ma ji bzhin du dbul zhing 'dod don la gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas cho ga lhag chad kha skang ba'i phyir du| dril bu dkrol ba sngon du 'gro bas yig brgya brjod/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ'ajig rten rnams rang gnas su gshegs shing dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bdag nyid la bzhugs par bya'o/ / gsum pa dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdu zhing dge rtsa rdzogs byang du sngo ba ni lte ba'i ye shes sems dpa' yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgyu ma'i dga' ba'i sgras 'gro ba rnams bkug ste zhes sogs nas*/ de bzhi yang rang ngos kyi gtso bo'i zhal bzhi la thim pa'i bar gyi phyi dkyil bsdus la/ lus dkyil gyi lha sgor mtshams ma brgyad sku 'khor la thims de gsung 'khor la dang*/ de thugs 'khor la/ de rnams kyang rnal 'byor ma bzhi thod pa dang bcas pa la bsdu zhing*/ de brgyad kyang nang gi he ru ka yab yum dang de gnyis kyang snying khar thims pas rtsa dang khams rnams byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ dam tshig pa yab yum sogs nas nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis he ru ka sngon po sogs gong gi thun mtshams kyi lha gsol 'debs bzhin du langs la/ srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ /'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems par ldan/ /he ru ka dpal de dang lhan cig gar byed shog/ ces dang lha mo tshad ma zhes sogs dang sngar gyi sems bskyed smon lam du bsgyur nas smon lam gdab pa dang*/ gzhan yang spyi dgos bsngo ba smon lam byas la/ rang gzhan gyis bsags pa'i dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo bar bya'o/

/ gnyis pa thun mtshams gzhan gyi rnal 'byor la drug las/ dang po bsrung ba ni/ rang phyag gnyis pa yum bcas langs pa la rang gi snying khar zla gdan la rdo rje sems pa'i ngo bo oṃ ha dkar zhes sogs sbyar nas/ dpral bar yan lag thams cad kyi lus dbang gi rang bzhin rta mchog gi ngo bo phaṭa haṃ ljang khu/ gtso mo'i lte bar nyi ma la rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ baṃ dmar po sogs nas/ dpral bar nyi ma la yan lag thams cad kyi lus dbang gi rang bzhin phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ spyi bo la sogs pa gnas nyer bzhi nyi gdan la/ pu dza oṃ a sogs nas ma ku rnams thig les brgyan pa rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs brjod cing*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis shar nas g.yon bskor du se gol tog cing mtshams ngaṃ sngags kyis bsrung ba yang bya'o/ / gnyis pa sgo gsum gyi spyod pa rnams thabs shes khyad par can gyis zin pa ni/ mthong thos la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog tu lta ba'i tshangs spyod la rtag tu gnas pa dang*/ bla ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi sku mthong ba'i tshe/ bde mchog tu mos nas/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod cing*/ rang nyid la yang des mchod par bya'o/ khams gsum gyi 'khor lo thams cad bde ba'i mchog lhan skyes kyi bde stong gi ngo bo dbyer med par sdoms pa la gnas nas/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin rgyas pa'i phyir du/ 'dod yon spyi dang bye brag la seng ge bzhin du mi 'jigs par longs spyad/ he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyi ngang nas lus kyi sgul bskyod dang*/ ngag gi smra brjod btang snyoms pa rnams kyis kyang phyag rgya bcing ba dang*/ sngags bzlas pa dang 'dra ba'i tshogs bsdud par gsungs pas spyod lam kun tu de'i nga rgyal rgyun ldan bya'o/ / gsum pa khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni chu dbang bskur ba'i skabs bzhin du bya'o| | bzhi pa zas kyi rnal 'byor ni kha zas kyi dus su ni rang gi lus dkyil skad cig gis gsal gdab/

kha zas kyi cha gcig gtor ma'i skyed chog ltar/ yang na yig ge gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs la oṃ kha kha zhes sogs lan gcig brjod de/ phyogs skyong la gtor ma dbul de nas rang gi bza' btung byin gyis rlobs pa ni lag pa g.yas pa ho dkar po las skyes pa'i 'khor lo rnam snang gi ngo bo ho yig gis mtshan pa bsam pa la bza' btung gi snod dngos su bzhag pa'am bzhag par mos pa bya/ lag pa g.yon pa la ha dmar po las skyes pa'i snang mtha'i rang bzhin pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa has mtshan pas kha dgab| rdzas kyi steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i hri sngon po mi skyod pa'i rang bzhin can bltas la/ sngags de lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun brjod la/ has kha dog dang hos dri dang*/ hriḥs nus pa'i skyon thams cad bcom zhing bdud rtsir sgyur bar bsam la/ hri'i g.yas su oṃ dkar po/ g.yon du āḥdamar po/ mdun du hūṃ sngon po gnas par bsam la yig ge gsum gsum mam bdun brjod la rgya cher spel zhing byin gyis brlab phud kyi bla ma dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma mchod nas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong par mnyam pa nyid du mos pa'i nga rgyal sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ sa ma ya shung+nghaḥ/ sarba dharma sa ma ya shung+ngho haṃ zhes brjod| lce rdo rjer bskyed pa 'am/ /lce la rdo rjer bskyed nas sngar bzhin byin gyis brlab ste/ longs spyad nas lte bar gnas pa'i hūm̐ 'am/ nā da dkar dmar lha thams cad kyi ngo bor mos te phul bas lha rnams tshim par bsam la longs spyod do/ /gzhan yang zhar la lam 'di thun bzhir nyams su len tshul ni/ thun dang po la sngar ji ltar bshad pa bzhin byas nas/ gung thun la ni bsam gtan gyi khang par zhugs te/ skad cig ma'i sngags gsum brjod pas/ skad cig gis rten brten pa'i 'khor lo rdzogs par mos pa bya ste/ sngar bzhin gsal gdab/ gtso bo yab yum gsal gdab zin pa dang/
gsang gnas byin brlabs sogs byas la bde stong bsgom/ 'khor rnams gsal gdab zin pa na'ang sngar ltar snyoms 'jug byas la/ chos so bdun gyi dag pa rgyas bsdus gang rung gcig dran par bya/

de nas lus dkyil bsgom de nas go cha bgo ba sogs sngar bzhin bya'o| |'grel pa rnams las dag pa gsum nas sbyor ba tshogs bsags gi bar rnams thun gzhan gsum la bya bar ma bshad kyang*/ bskyed rim la sems las rung gi ting nge 'dzin ma thob bar du ma chags pa re dang stong pa'i ngang nas nā da 'jog pa nas mngon byang bsgom pa'i bar byas na legs so/ /thun de btang nas phyi dro'i thun dang mtshan mo'i thun la'ang ngo/ / lnga pa nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ thun thams cad kyi mthar nam gyi gung la ngag gi bya ba thams cad ā li kā li bdag nyid du khong du chud par byas la/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon dpa' bo che/ /dag pa'i tshig ni ston pa po/ /skye dang 'jig dang rang byung ba/ /stong nyid ye shes 'di kho na'o/ /zhes brjod cing mgor bor oṃ dang mthar hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar ba'i dbyangs gsal tshar gcig brjod la/ bsdud rim snying khar byas nas nā da yang mi dmigs par byas pa'i 'og tu sems g.yo med du bzung na/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal 'dzin pa stobs che'o/ /thun mtshams bzhi po thams cad kyi thog mthar yig brgya ci mang brjod do/ /drug pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ de nas yang tho rangs kyi thun la/ 'od gsal las langs te/ oṃ tshur byon sogs brjod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi cang rte'u'i sgras gnyid las slang bar mos nas/ lus dkyil gyi 'khor lo wal gyis dran par byas la thun dang po'i mgo nas rim pa bzhin nyams su blang ngo*/ /de ltar lam 'di bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni/ bskyed rim rnal 'byor bzhi bsgoms pas/ rdzogs rim rim pa lnga sogs yongs rdzogs skye ba'i rgyud smin zhing*/ rdzogs rim yang mtshan nyid tshang bar skyes te/ tshe 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa 'thob pa dang*| tshe 'dir de ma thob kyang skye ba brgyud nas 'thob ste/ de yang theg pa mchog gi rigs su skye ba dang*/ chos 'di spyod pa'i chos ldan gyi rgyal por 'gyur ba dang*/
